correctness.rationale: The normalized vertex/cut definitions and the complete cut and rectangle Frobenius inner products are reconstructed in the proof. A feasible two-cut point has identical active gradients and explicitly nonnegative gaps at all remaining cuts; the projection inequality proves global optimality and strict convexity gives uniqueness. The exact distance formula is algebraic. All other vertices lie at squared distance at most 1/4, while the unique corner exceeds 1/4 in n>=4; the n=3 case is handled separately, and convexity excludes nonvertex maximizers. The finite exact rational standalone checker independently recomputes matrices and verifies these identities in 15179 parameter cases through n=45; computation is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The metric face is the geometrically and operationally distinguished subclass of Monge cost arrays satisfying the triangle inequality, identified by Erickson--Kretschmann. The result gives exact normalized Frobenius proximity to valid path pseudometrics for every extremal Monge cost, an unexpectedly two-cut optimal support, a complete family of rational distances, and the unique deepest nonmetric matrix with nonvanishing dimension-asymptotic gap. The exact support and distinction from unattained nearest genuine metrics make this a substantive geometric approximation invariant.
